status: Development after the three additional prediction labels were exposed
motivation: Pyrrole virtual native orbitals have fragmented full-DFT spectral weight and fail individual orbital qualification
rule_scope: Every previously unqualified occupied and virtual orbital of every molecule; individually qualified poles remain unchanged
qualification: Smallest descending spectral-weight set reaching cumulative squared norm 0.7^2, within the same occupation sector
Q_level: Normalized spectral centroid, aligned using the unchanged occupied-centroid gauge
F_relaxation: Spectral centroid minus Rayleigh energy of the original native image
bath: Rebuild explicit orthogonal-bath screening on corrected native orbitals
limitation: Centroid approximation; broad spectral blocks need independent prospective and anchor-sensitivity validation
